Unknown posix, xtg and long language tags incorrectly borrow script and
region from und. That changes maximize/minimize results and infers a
text direction when Add Likely Subtags must report a semantic miss.

canonical tag on no-match, stop minimize trials before comparing absent
fields, and guard territory-alias selection when inference has no
region. Keep resource/data errors distinct from semantic misses.

explicit scripts, extensions, idempotence, territory aliases and known
en/und/zh inference controls.

intl: admit plain reference dates in named-zone range queries

Valid extreme PlainYearMonth references reach ToLocalTime while range
comparison uses the formatter's named zone. The date provider permits 32
extra epoch days, but qjs_tzif_info rejects beyond Instant plus two
days. The zone bridge maps that rejection to OVERFLOW and the frontend
reports out of memory for valid plain input.

Give only the civil info lookup a bounded Instant plus 33 day guard. The
date provider validates the floor epoch-day quotient; its positive 32nd
extra day includes seconds up to the start of the 33rd extra day. The
existing state_info lookup already supports wider bounded CLDR
name-stability windows. Preserve Instant offset and transition guards.

Add semantic boundary-range and same-value shared-parts regressions to
the existing native Temporal bank fixture. Compare years with endpoint
parts and strings with part concatenation without prescribing localized
punctuation or optional interval compression. Preserve Make's census.

intl: add fractional records before native date matching

Native calendar banks contain no fractional-second patterns. Basic
matching therefore drops fractionalSecondDigits from the selected
record. Best fit appends a fraction only after ranking, so it cannot
repair the required format bank used by both matchers.

Add conceptual decimal+S/SS/SSS variants of available seconds records
and date/time joins. Rank complete records before matcher adjustment,
then render the selected fraction through the existing decimal/part
path. Keep base and join order, strict first-on-tie selection, and the
style path. Skip variants dominated by a base or the exact precision; no
synthetic pattern arrays or extra no-fraction passes are needed.

Add regressions to the existing all-calendars unit for both matchers,
all 16 calendars, precision 1/2/3, required fractional subsets, leading
zeros, truncation, negative epochs, joined parts, and fraction/style
controls. The separate era-bearing mandatory-subset defect remains for
the following era-free bank repair.

repairs.semantics_from_authentic_message:
intl: add era-free records to native date format banks

Eleven native calendar banks omit 55 mandatory field subsets. Their
available year/date patterns include an era, so an era-bearing superset
cannot supply a required record using the same subset of fields. Basic
and best fit can consequently emit an unrequested era.

Append parsed era-free siblings of available pure-date patterns whose G
token is at a boundary with a space separator. Each sibling owns a slice
of the copied pattern with G and its separator removed. Derive its
fields from that actual pattern, then include its date/time joins and
fractional variants in matching. Retain the entire original bank first
and strict first-on-tie selection. Requested-era and style formats
retain their original records.

Add required-subset regressions to the existing all-calendars unit for
en/en-US, both matchers, all 16 calendars and fraction widths 1/2/3.
Check exact selected fields, genuine parts and absence of era, plus
requested-era and style-era controls. Retain fractional truncation,
leading-zero and negative-epoch coverage.
